best_idea: A fixed pool of voices where each sound carries a priority and rule flags (one copy anywhere, no duplicate, no re-trigger from the same source), audibility is checked before a voice is taken, and a per-frame pass frees voices whose sound has ended or gone out of range.
decision_why: Keep the pool, the rule flags and audible-before-voice order, which fit a many-hit fight and a readability cap at 375 wide. Change the steal to the lowest priority (ties oldest), check duplicate rules across all voices, and normalise the distance ramp from full volume at 160 units, because the donor has all three defects.
acceptance: A client test in a fight with a pool of 8 voices: 12 grunt hits (priority 64) and one boss telegraph (priority 200) start in one frame; the telegraph always plays, stopped voices are lowest-priority and oldest first, and a second copy of a no-multiple sound never starts while one plays.
